sloka: हतम् च रावणम् उद्धे दर्शनादवधारय ।अबद्ध्वा सागरे सेतुम् घोरे च वरुणालये ॥६-२-११॥।।
transliteration: hatam ca rāvaṇam uddhe darśanādavadhāraya ।abaddhvā sāgare setum ghore ca varuṇālaye ॥6-2-11॥।।

translations.english: "Without building a bridge on that dreadful ocean, the abode of Varuna, it is not possible for suras or asuras accompanied by Indra also to crush Lanka."
